title: The test script that qa writes is lost when the campaign is destroyed
foundBy: user report (host): "does the QA generate any automated tests too? did we ask it to do that?"
details:
The qa brief asks for a report and never asks for a test. In two runs qa wrote a Playwright script anyway, at `/tmp/verify.mjs` inside its sandbox. The script loads the served page, asserts the `data-component` attributes and the greeting, clicks each colour button, and exits 1 on any failure.

Only the prose report is committed, and the archive does not collect `/tmp`. The orchestrator's branch never receives qa's branch either. So `make demo-destroy` deletes the one runnable check the campaign produced.

The fix is two brief changes. The qa member commits the script under `tests/` and names the command that runs it. The orchestrator fetches qa, merges the script, and runs it once against its own server before it replies. The cost is Playwright as a dev dependency of the delivered app.
